title: Okapi BM25 Search, Neural Song Announcer & Mobile Playback Polish
description: Upgraded global search with Okapi BM25 scoring, added AI Neural Song Announcer with native script pronunciation and dual-voice stitching, polished player controls, and enhanced offline background playback.
changes: Upgraded global search engine to Okapi BM25 scoring algorithm with weighted relevance across titles, artists, albums, and lyrics
Added English stop-word filtering to prevent common terms from skewing artist search results
Streamlined search dropdown results by removing redundant lyrics snippets for a cleaner, unified presentation
Added clickable artist links on album headers to navigate directly to dedicated artist discographies
Integrated Microsoft Edge Neural TTS announcer that speaks upcoming track titles upon song completion
Implemented dual-voice stitching to seamlessly announce multi-lingual tracks with mixed title and artist languages
Added narration_text column to catalog database with verified native script transliterations for Bengali, Hindi, Korean, and Japanese titles
Added Song Announcer toggle switch and dedicated narrator volume slider inside the navbar settings menu
Re-centered mobile player play and pause controls by streamlining playback capsule layout
Bumped disabled shuffle button opacity during AI Autoplay queues to match inactive lyrics styling
Prevented mobile browser reload and audio pause when switching back into the app while disconnected from network
Added visibilitychange and pageshow listeners to automatically resume active playback when returning from background
Preserved playback active state and exact seek position across tab refreshes and memory cleanups

title: ⚡Persistent Player, Modern UI & Mobile Polish⚡
description: Space-consuming player layout, universal sleek scrollbars, enhanced lyrics experience, and mobile queue fixes.
changes: Converted desktop player from fixed overlay into persistent document flow so scrollbars and content terminate cleanly above the bar
Added IdlePlayer bar on desktop with interactive volume control and queue access when no track is playing
Replaced Windows default scrollbar stepper arrows with universal slim, transparent scrollbars and lavender hover highlights
Made lyrics button always interactive with adaptive opacity and unlocked lyrics access for logged-out users
Redesigned the 'No Lyrics Available' state with a glassmorphic badge, ambient glow, and dedicated loading spinner
Upgraded music playing indicator to a smooth, fluid lavender soundwave visualizer
Added floating timestamp preview tooltip on player seekbar that follows the cursor position
Fixed mobile queue songs not being tappable to play; now the entire row (title, artist, artwork) is responsive to touch
Protected like button and drag handle from triggering accidental playback when tapped on touchscreens
Fixed context menu auto-dismissing when the lyrics player automatically scrolls to the active line
Increased brightness and contrast of current time and duration labels on the player bar
Refined desktop play/pause button sizing and bottom padding to provide comfortable breathing room

title: ⚡Download Controls & Queue Polish⚡
description: Added pause/resume download controls, in-view fuzzy search, offline search fallback, and comprehensive queue fixes.
changes: Added pause, resume, and cancel controls for playlist and album downloads
Preserved partially downloaded songs in offline database for immediate playback
Implemented real-time green checkmark badge for downloaded songs across views and queue
Added in-view fuzzy search bar for playlists, albums, and liked songs
Fixed search bar recent searches displaying default vinyl icon instead of album art
Added IndexedDB fallback for search suggestions when launched offline from taskbar
Fixed ML playlist search navigation causing unexpected offline screen
Fixed queue bottom padding to prevent the last song hiding behind the bottom player
Fixed blank black space in queue when playing newly added tracks from context
Fixed unliked songs lingering in liked songs queue by synchronizing context IDs
Resolved Next.js dev infinite compiling loop on /liked during hydration
Added hover tooltips for truncated song, artist, and album titles
Fixed remove download menu positioning behind sidebar with z-index elevation
Improved contrast of inactive lyric lines in lyrics sync admin tool

title: ⚡Revamped Playback⚡
description: Extended library with newer songs.
changes: Improved lyrics player, syncs well with lines, less stray lines.
Auto download for synced playlists and albums.
Fixed infinte rendering loops.
Fixed bug with fuse js where the cached images were showing all default.

title: ⚡Offline Capabilites⚡
description: PWA Support with offline mode.
changes: You can install the website as progressive web app.
You can use the website offline. Dedicated offline toggle button as well.
Changed certain visual elements.
New logo, rebranded MuseBuzz.
Used dixie DB to mirror local database like Supabase storage.
Improved mobile view for better UI and UX.

title: ⚡New Update⚡
description: Update.
changes: An update was done.

title: ⚡Mobile Native Polish Update⚡
description: New mobile animations, style, functionalities.
changes: Native Hardware Navigation: Deep integration with mobile hardware back-buttons—seamlessly back out of the Queue, Lyrics, and Player layers without accidentally closing the app.
Buttery-Smooth UI: Implemented squish-free sliding animations for panel transitions, and replaced the desktop context menu with a custom, touch-friendly Bottom Sheet for mobile.
Smarter Lyrics Sync: Rewrote the lyrics algorithm to perfectly track vocals even through long instrumental solos, and fixed UI layout overlaps.
Player Layout Polish: Fixed infinite-looping marquee text, corrected 'Like' button spacing to dynamically hug track titles, and decoupled the volume slider to prevent accidental song resets.

title: ⚡ Mobile Gestures & UX Polish ⚡
description: Introduced smooth swipe gestures for mobile search, fixed the queue rearranging touch bug, and refined overall navigation layouts.
changes: Added a dedicated Fullscreen Search Experience on mobile with a clean icon trigger.
Implemented Swipe Left to delete Search History items on phone view.
Implemented Swipe Right to instantly Add to Queue from both Search History and live song results.
Fixed the unscrollable Mobile Queue bug where dragging a song vertically conflicted with horizontal swipe animations.
Redesigned the main Header. The raw 'Logout' button is now cleanly tucked away inside a Profile Avatar dropdown.
Corrected the Mobile Expanded Player Header alignment so that 'Now Playing', the down-arrow, and the 3-dots menu are precisely centered using a mathematical grid structure.
Re-anchored the Desktop Search bar to its intended left-aligned position alongside the menu.

title: ⚡ Dual Howler & Queue Fixes ⚡
description: Decoupled the queue using two Howler instances for better functionality and fixed the empty context queue bug.
changes: Decoupled the queue to better function using two Howler instances.
Fixed the queue bug where an empty context still showed the text 'end of list', which has now been removed.

title: ⚡ Redefined Search Bar and Lyrics Sync ⚡
description: Added search history in search bar and changed lyrics sync logic.
changes: Added scrollable container in the search where you can view search history as well as search many more items by scrolling.
Improved the search context, now many contexts are taken into consideration. You can search by playlists, albums, song names, artist names, even lyrics.
Lyrics sync happen automatically when you reload the page and the lyrics panel is open.
Attempted to change Howler js logic, to add delay after each song so that previous song does not bleed into the next one. However, this has failed and the songs still bleed.
Lyrics/Queue panel now keeps the open/closed state stored in the browser cache.

title: ⚡ Redefined Search Bar and Lyrics Sync ⚡
description: Added search history in search bar and changed lyrics sync logic.
changes: Added scrollable container in the search where you can view search history as well as search many more items by scrolling.
Improved the search context, now many contexts are taken into consideration. You can search by playlists, albums, song names, artist names, even lyrics.
Lyrics sync happen automatically when you reload the page and the lyrics panel is open.
Attempted to change Howler js logic, to add delay after each song so that previous song does not bleed into the next one. However, this has failed and the songs still bleed.
Lyrics/Queue panel now keeps the open/closed state stored in the browser cache.

title: ⚡ Better Lyrics Panel Look ⚡
description: Changed the look of the buttons in the lyrics panel.
changes: Changed the button look in the lyrics panel.
Improved the visibility of the translations.
Changed the cursor-pointer attribute in like button on the player, and the translate button.

title: ⚡ Native Languages Support in Lyrics ⚡
description: Now songs other than English has native language support with English translation.
changes: Modifed the admin page to support multilingual songs.
The lyrics panel features buttons to toggle different options like English-lettered lyrics, or native language lyrics, or show / hide the translation.
Modified the lyrics sync so that the sync doesn't break when doing other things like dragging seek bar or scrolling outside. There might still be minor issues with sync.

title: ⚡Lyrics Window⚡
description: Added lyrics for certain songs, and a lyrics sync for the admins.
changes: Added lyrics button on the player which opens the lyrics window beside the queue button.

Added a lyrics syncing page for the admins. They can press space bar as the song is playing to sync lines with audio. Regular users are not supposed to access this. For now, this is public, but we will change it later, maybe.
User can scroll on the lyrics window up and down. Resume Sync button appears to let them get back to the current line.
User can also click on a line to go to that timestamp directly.

title: ⚡New Loader, Queue, and Homepage Arrows⚡
description: Fixed minor issues with loading screens, queue emergence, and visible arrows in each row-wise section of the homepage.
changes: Fixed shifting of layout because of items were loading gradually with a new loading icon.
Used the same loading icon for page-to-page navigation.
Queue window from the right now appears below the header.

Fixed issue with the homepage rows where the arrows on each row did not appear when queue or sidebar was opened and then visible space decreased. Now the arrow presence are re-calculated after those actions.

title: ⚡Changed Login System⚡
description: Removed Email verification for login
changes: Now, you dont have to verify emails for login.
If you use google login, then you still have to use a real google account.
Fixed an issue where states where bleeding across accounts if you logged out and logged in the same browser in the same device without clearing cache.
Fixed auth modal issue where modal didn't close after login.

title: ⚡AI Playlists Re-defined⚡
description: AI Generated Playlists use a custom machine learning model which takes in factors from your listening history, followed artists, added albums, skipped and completed songs
changes: Used PyTorch for the machine learning model. Gemini API is used to creatively name those generated playlists ensuring the names are unique and does not repeat the same names back-to-back.

The details fetched are listening history, saved albums and artists, songs the user skipped or completed, also their duration, and the date of the added entry in the database to penalise old listening habits and bring forward new ones.
Fixed an issue with Generated Playlists page, where the 'Date Added' for each song was showing 'Mix For You'. Now the dates of each song is the same as the time the playlist is made.

title: ⚡Customised Homepage, AI Playlists, and Context Menus⚡
description: AI Generated Playlists, Context aware right-click, and add entire context to priority queue.
changes: Logged in user can see generated playlists that are made for them based on their listening history.
The homepage is also curated, with 'Jump Back In' section, 'More Like ...' section, and 'Made For You' Customised Generated Playlists section.
You can now right-click most contexts and get the proper context menu, relevant to that context.
Added a new 'Add to Queue' option for playlists, generated playlists, albums and artists which will be added to the priority queue.
Changed the look of the context menu which is now consistent everywhere.
Added a 'Clear' button on the priority queue which you can click and reset the entire priority queue. Context queue works normally.

title: ⚡Similar Songs in the Queue⚡
description: Based on your last songs of your playlist / album, new auto-play songs will be generated.
changes: There are now three buckets in the queue - priority, context, and autoplay.
You cannot move songs from one bucket to another but you can re-arrange in itself.
The autoplay songs are generated based on the last 5 songs of your playlist / album.
The last song has the most influence on the queue. The other 4 songs have average influence on the queue.

title: ⚡Artist Page⚡
description: The Artist Page has been built!
changes: You can open artist pages from the search bar or the player by clicking on the artist name.
You can follow artists and they will appear on your library page. They also get sorted reverse chronologically based on when you accessed them.
In the artist page, you can see their profile picture, and the songs they have in album wise order for now. You can play songs from there and it is a separate play context.
If you click on the image on the player on the extreme left, you will go to that song's album, if you click on the artist name then you will go to the artist page.
Added a marquee scroll effect in case the width is not enough for the song name to appear on the player.
Added a new filter option for artists on the 'Your Library' page.
New context menus for adding artists has been added.
Added 'Save to Library' button on the album header, beside the title.

title: ⚡Your Library Page and Sleeker Sidebar⚡
description: The 'Your Library' page is designed to show your recently added / played playlists and albums.
changes: Your Library page shows you recently added / last accessed albums and playlists in reverse chronological order.
The sidebar shows the first 10 entries from 'Your Library' page.
Side bar contains the icons of the albums and playlists and they get re-arranged as you access them.
You can filter the content of 'Your Library' to show just the albums or playlists or all.
Playlists and Liked Songs page shows the album cover image beside the song title as well.

title: ⚡Persistent Player⚡
description: Closing the browser while playing won't remove your current song and queue.
changes: You can play a song from a context and go away. When you come back, that song will be there along with the context and the timestamp.
Added Odia Language to the greetings.

title: ⚡Custom Playlists⚡
description: You can now create custom playlists.
changes: You can now create custom playlists, rename them, delete them.

There is a new right-click context menu that appears on the global search, album songs, liked songs and other playlists from where you can add songs to a specific playlist. In playlists section, you can also remove songs by right-clicking.
The 'Song Addition to Playlist' modal opens up and displays all your playlists in alphabetical order.

Later, we will build the 'Your Library' page, but for now, you can see all your playlists in the homepage, under the title 'Your Playlists'. You can see your last 5 recently accessed playlists on the sidebar.
Changed the look of the volume slider where it appears only on hover.

title: ⚡Stabilised Features and Simplified Approach⚡
description: Added persistency to liked songs, changed queue mechanisms, changed vibes.
changes: If you turn on 'shuffle' or change 'repeat' mode for a playlist or album, that status is stored in the database. So, even when you come back later, it is remembered.
Queue window on the right is resizable now. The last size is stored in your browser's cache so it is device specific, not account specific so you don't have to constantly change it.

You can no longer drag songs from the context queue to the priority queue and vice-versa. This prevents unnecessary bugs and stabilises queue performance. An easy mechanism is introduced, if you click and drag a context queue song right, you can add it to the priority queue and then re-arrange it from there if you absolutely need to.
You can remove songs from the priority and context queue by using the 'X' button or by dragging left.
Changed main seek slider and volume slider colour from white to purple to match the theme.

title: ⚡ Modern Queue ⚡
description: Rearrange songs in the queue.
changes: Changed the queue to a small component from a dedicated page
Move the songs around the queue as you wish
Improved queue animations
Changed the home horizontal arrow colours for better visibility
Local cached like button to prevent appearance delay

title: ⚡ Search Function! ⚡
description: Now you can search for a song easily.
changes: Added search bar
You can add to queue directly from search
You can like from search bar as well

title: ⚡ Quality of Life Improvements ⚡
description: A lot of tiny changes to make your life easier. Still there are some very specific bugs which need to be taken care of.
changes: Liked Songs playlist with framer-motion animation
Like Songs playlist heading for easy column identification
Clickable album name on the Liked Songs playlist
Added the 'Add To Queue' button beside the heart button
You can now add songs from anywhere to the queue
You can click on album names to redirect to respective album in queue page
Added queue page animation, handled wrapping of songs at start and end

title: ⚡ New Modal Fetch Method ⚡
description: Now changing just a JSON file will automatically fetch the update details for the modal.
changes: Fixed an issue with Liked Songs playlist where in view liked songs didn't appear
Fixed seekbar and timer syncing issues when switching contexts
Corrected volume slider behavior to prevent accidental song restarts
Added smooth hover effects to the playback slider handle

title: Context Aware Playback! ⚡
description: Now the player is fully aware of exactly where your song is being played from.
changes: Isolated song playback state between Album and Liked contexts
Fixed seekbar and timer syncing issues when switching contexts
Corrected volume slider behavior to prevent accidental song restarts
Added smooth hover effects to the playback slider handle

title: Initial Release
description: Welcome to MuseBuzz!
changes: Core music streaming engine live
Supabase authentication integration
Full library and album support
